summary: Iteration 3 (Reguler/Express dual-pricing + per-outlet pricelists) fully verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 17/17 PASS against public URL (username/password auth updated in tests). GET /api/services?outlet_id={depok|jakarta|bandung} returns exactly 41/43/43 active services with fields price, price_express, duration, duration_express, min_kg, category, outlet_id. POST/PUT /api/services persists all new columns (price_express=18000, duration='1 Hari', duration_express='4 Jam', min_kg=5 all round-trip). Order create with express price: POST /api/orders with 5x18000 -> total 90000 (verified in test_order_with_express_price_total). Frontend (390x844 mobile web): Owner login owner/owner123 works, FAB fab-buat-order opens /order-baru. Outlet chips (outlet-pick-Depok/Jakarta/Bandung) render as 'Kalimulya/Pulomas/Ujungberung' labels. Services grouped by category (KILOAN, ADD-ON, BED COVER, SELIMUT, BANTAL & GULING, BONEKA, ATASAN, ...). Each service with express shows testIDs speed-<uuid>-regular / speed-<uuid>-express; toggling Express updates displayed price (Rp10.000 -> Rp18.000 for Cuci Kering Setrika) and running total updates in bottom bar (5 x Rp18.000 = Rp90.000 confirmed). Switching outlet chip from Kalimulya -> Ujungberung reloads Bandung-specific pricelist (Cuci Kering Setrika Rp6.900) and resets cart to '0 item / Rp0'. Customer picker works, Konfirmasi Sudah Bayar submits order and returns to /home dashboard (13 transaksi visible). Setelan > Produk & Layanan: three outlet tabs work; row shows regular price/duration and 'Express Rp.../ ... Jam' subline; add-service modal exposes fields Harga Reguler, Harga Express, Durasi Reguler, Durasi Express, Minimal Kg. Per-outlet service counts as shown in UI (include_inactive=true): Depok 42, Jakarta 43, Bandung 43 (Depok +1 because our test suite created one TEST_Svc). No regressions.

ui_bugs.issue: On first landing (deep-linked navigation) no outlet tab is auto-selected, showing 'Belum ada layanan' until the user taps a tab. session.currentOutletId may not be set at hydration time. Workaround: fallback to outlets[0].id already in code but session may still be undefined on first render.

react_native_issues.issue: Persistent RN-Web console deprecation: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: in /app/frontend/app/manage/produk.tsx, useEffect to set outletId to outlets[0].id when session hydrates so the first tab is auto-selected on deep-link.
Optional: migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow to silence RN-Web deprecation warning.
Cleanup: one TEST_Svc_* row is now visible under Kalimulya (Depok) via include_inactive; recommend a periodic Supabase cleanup of TEST_ prefixed rows.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 1341 lines - still monolithic. Consider splitting into modules (services/orders/reports/masterdata).
order-baru.tsx priceOf() correctly falls back to regular price when speed=='express' but svc.price_express is null - defensive and correct.
produk.tsx correctly sends price_express=null when field left empty (String '' -> null) so backend column stays NULL.
seed_data_creation: TestServiceCRUD created one TEST_Svc_<hex> row for Depok. TestExpressOrder + TestServiceCRUD also created several test orders (paid/unpaid) for the first customer at Depok and at Jakarta. No customer records created this run.
